patch.value: Preserve explicit FileId intent for ambiguous edited moves

Same-inode rename plus edit and unambiguous unchanged-content moves retain FileIds today. An edited move across filesystems can lose both inode and content evidence, so guessing can conflate independent files. Add an explicit native move or identity-mapping operation with collision and erasure guards.
An explicitly declared edited move retains its FileId and PM ChangeId trace across filesystems; independent copies keep new identities; ambiguous inference never silently picks an unrelated source.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Design: add explicit FileId mapping to native staging, validated under the shared writer lease and committed in the existing index/tree identity fields. Reserve declared identities before inference; return typed ambiguous_move with candidate paths and a concrete remedy for tied move evidence. Align three-way merge inputs by unique FileId before content merging so replay uses the same path. Tests will cover adversarial pairing, seeded oracle sequences, separate processes, and crash/retry/clone convergence. Full release certification remains in CI as requested.
